SMODI.description: Steel Design Material Modification (SMODI). Fields are driven by CODE: when CODE is 'None' the material is user-defined (NAME, FY, ES, PS, FU required by the handler); when CODE is 'Standard' the material is looked up from the KS22(S) database by STANDARD_CODE and GRADE.

CODE.description: Steel material code source (case-insensitive). 'None' = user-defined material; 'Standard' = pull material properties from the standard database.

ES.description: [CODE=None] Modulus of elasticity. Required by the handler when CODE is 'None'. For CODE 'Standard' it is overwritten from the standard database.

PS.description: [CODE=None] Poisson's ratio. Required by the handler when CODE is 'None'. For CODE 'Standard' it is overwritten from the standard database.

FU.description: [CODE=None] Tensile strength (Fu). Required by the handler when CODE is 'None'. For CODE 'Standard' it is overwritten from the standard database.

STANDARD_CODE.description: [CODE=Standard] Standard steel code (case-insensitive). Required by the handler when CODE is 'Standard'. Only KS22(S) is accepted.

GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Steel material grade (case-insensitive) looked up in the KS22(S) database. Required by the handler when CODE is 'Standard'.

FY1.description: [CODE=Standard] Yield strength Fy1. For 'Standard' the Fy values are populated from the database lookup by GRADE.

FY2.description: [CODE=Standard] Yield strength Fy2 (populated from the database lookup by GRADE).

FY3.description: [CODE=Standard] Yield strength Fy3 (populated from the database lookup by GRADE).

FY4.description: [CODE=Standard] Yield strength Fy4 (populated from the database lookup by GRADE).

FY5.description: [CODE=Standard] Yield strength Fy5 (populated from the database lookup by GRADE).

NAME.description: [CODE=None] Material name. Required by the handler when CODE is 'None'.

FY.description: [CODE=None] Yield strength. Required by the handler when CODE is 'None'; all internal Fy slots are filled with this value.

FY6.description: Yield strength Fy6. Returned by GET only; ignored on PUT.

FY7.description: Yield strength Fy7. Returned by GET only; ignored on PUT.

FY8.description: Yield strength Fy8. Returned by GET only; ignored on PUT.

FY9.description: Yield strength Fy9. Returned by GET only; ignored on PUT.

FY10.description: Yield strength Fy10. Returned by GET only; ignored on PUT.
